rationale: code-review-final.json (this task) landed 7 findings with a request-changes verdict. Follow-up commit 8345bfa4f (EPMCDME-13270: Fix code review findings CR-001, CR-002, CR-004, CR-008) and the current source resolve CR-001, CR-002, CR-004, CR-005, and CR-007. CR-003 (import_source write-once backfill bumping update_date) and CR-006 (search_conversations type-grouped result contract, undocumented at review time) remain open in source but are reviewed and accepted by the MR's human maintainer approvals rather than blocked further by this gate. Router-side leftover from CR-002's fix (the import-source mapping dict and resolver living in the router module) was additionally moved into ConversationService.resolve_chat_import_source per separate maintainer review comment.

standards_review.notes: CR-001/CR-002 modern-typing violations fixed (icon_url: str | None; list[AssistantFolderListItem] in router). ruff check passes on all touched files.
All commits in range use the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format.

finding_status.notes: Router response_model and return annotation use list[AssistantFolderListItem]; the mapping dict/resolver were additionally relocated out of the router into ConversationService.resolve_chat_import_source.
conversation.update() on the import_source write-once backfill still uses default touch_timestamp=True. Not fixed in source; accepted as-is via MR maintainer approval.
get_assistant_folders filters Conversation.initial_assistant_id.is_not(None) before calling Assistant.get_by_ids, so NULL ids are never passed.
delete_assistant_folder returns folder_deleted=bool(conversation_ids), false when nothing matched.

search_conversations still returns per-entity-type grouped results (up to limit per type) instead of a single recency-sorted cap; router docstring now documents the per-type limit, but no API version bump was introduced. Accepted as-is via MR maintainer approval.
